name: magic-card

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the gradient card's spotlight brightest, clearly following the cursor.

tagline: A dark card whose border glow follows the pointer as it moves.
summary: A rounded card wrapper that tracks the pointer. A soft spotlight glides along its border and surface, or in orb mode a blurred purple-orange bloom drifts behind the content, fading when the cursor leaves.
appearance: Two small dark rounded cards side by side on a near-black stage, each holding a tiny line icon, a bold white label and a dim hint line. The borders are barely visible until a pale or coloured glow gathers at the pointer.
behaviour: Moving the pointer across a card drags a soft radial glow along its border and across the surface. The orb card shows a blurred purple-orange bloom instead, and both fade away when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: "Gradient mode" and "Orb mode" cards with hints to hover for a gradient or glowing orb.
search_phrases: card with a glow that follows the mouse
use_when: A small card grid should feel responsive to the pointer without a loud hover animation.
avoid_when: The glow is pointer-only, so touch and keyboard users never see it, and it needs a theme provider.
customise: Gradient size and colours, or orb glow colours, angle, size, blur and opacity are props; the card body is whatever children you pass.
weight_why: Two motion values drive a CSS gradient; no canvas and no animation loop.

a11y.note: The glow responds to pointer movement only, so keyboard and touch users get no visual feedback, and reduced-motion is ignored.

issues: The glow responds only to a pointer, so keyboard and touch users see plain cards.
The demo cards hold only placeholder text and icons passed in by the demo.
polish_why: Restrained dark cards and a smooth spotlight; the effect is subtle and pointer-only.
title: Magic Card
